name: @projexlight/config
summary: Typed environment + config loader — reads process.env, parses + validates against a Zod-style schema, surfaces friendly errors at boot. Every SDK + service exposes its config_keys through this loader so misconfiguration fails-closed at startup rather than at request time.

hooks.name: loadConfig
hooks.description: Parse process.env against a schema; throws on missing required fields.

hooks.name: describeMissing
hooks.description: Diagnostic helper — lists exactly which env keys are missing for a given schema.

scenarios.title: Service boot fails fast on missing required env
scenarios.when_to_use: Every service startup. If DATABASE_URL is missing, loadConfig throws before any worker spawns.
scenarios.example_code:
import { loadConfig } from '@projexlight/config';
const cfg = loadConfig(GatewaySchema, process.env);
scenarios.expected_outcome: Misconfigured deploys fail at boot, never at request time. Operator sees the exact missing keys.

scenarios.title: Config object is type-narrowed for downstream consumers
scenarios.when_to_use: Downstream code reads cfg.PORT as number (parsed + bounded) instead of string from raw env.

scenarios.title: describeMissing helps operators diagnose
scenarios.when_to_use: CI pre-flight or operator console — lists exactly which env keys a service needs without booting it.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Operator sees the full diff between required + present. No boot attempt needed.

compliance_posture.notes: Fail-closed on missing config eliminates a whole class of mis-deploys. Secrets never logged — schema validation reports key names only.
